item.title: What is Matsa Shemura?
item.description:
Update from Dayan Kada: I have just verified with Rakusens Matsah that all Matsah they bake (even not Shemurah Matsah) is made לשם מצות מצה - for the purpose of Matsah and therefore satisfies the second point mentioned in the voice note.
Therefore, in conclusion, in extenuating circumstances one fulfils the Mitsvah of Matsah Shemurah with such Matsah and a blessing may be recited upon it.
